phases.title: Volunteer Scheduling for Opening and Closing
phases.intro: The club only opens if volunteers do: a desk organizer with the key, a money collector, table setup, and at the end a lock-up and people to put tables away. The volunteer app on the website lets players pick those shifts weeks ahead, confirms them by email, and the desk shows tonight's crew when they arrive.

steps.title: A student books a lesson
steps.summary: The student picks a time, fills in the form and presses **Send request**, checks the details in the confirm box and presses **Confirm submission**. The confirm box shows *We will email the coach’s answer to:* with the address in large bold type and an **✎ Edit** button, so a mistyped address can be fixed right there. The coach is asked at once by email (and text if registered) and replies YES or NO. Both get *Lesson confirmed* with each other's contact details.
steps.subtext: A request waits up to 48 hours for the coach, and expires 12 hours before the lesson (or at its start on short notice).
caveats: Every email carries a six-character booking code; `?log=CODE` on the app shows exactly where a booking is.
